name: Cemita Burger With Refried Beans, Chipotle Mayo, Avocado, and Oaxacan Cheese

ingredients.name: chipotle chilis, canned in adobo sauce, divided
thin tomato slices, from 2 medium tomatoes
ripe Hass avocado, halved, pitted, and sliced

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise and the 2 tablespoons adobo sauce. Set aside.

Season burger patties generously with salt and pepper and cook burgers to desired doneness on an oiled hot griddle, grill, or in 2 large skillets on the stovetop, 52°C for medium rare or 57°C for medium. Transfer to a plate and allow to rest for 5 minutes.
Toast cut surfaces of buns on the griddle, grill, or skillets, pressing down with a sturdy spatula to compress.

Spread refried beans on bottom bun halves, then top with shredded iceberg, papalo or cilantro leaves, tomato, and burger patties. Set avocado slices on top of burger patties, top with mounds of shredded cheese, followed by the remaining 4 chipotle peppers.
Spread chipotle mayonnaise on top bun halves and close sandwiches. Serve right away.

description: What do you get when you take Mexico's greatest sandwich and combine it with a good ol' all-beef burger from the U.S. of A.? Why, the cemita burger, claro! Refrieds, chipotle, avocado, shredded cheese, lettuce, tomato, and more come together for this extravaganza of burger toppings.
notes: Optional substitutions: Vegetable oil → for the griddle or grill or skillets; cemita buns → sesame-seed buns or brioche buns
author: Daniel Gritzer
